Somos Astralys, un equipo apasionado por la exploración espacial y la narrativa visual. 

Buscamos mentes creativas y colaborativas con habilidades en animación, artes multimedia, diseño gráfico y storytelling que quieran unirse a nosotros para transformar datos en historias inolvidables. ¿Te apasiona el espacio y quieres contar su historia desde una perspectiva única? ¡Súmate a nuestro equipo y hagámoslo realidad!
summary: ASTROMARS is an interactive application designed to help users explore Mars and understand the challenges of future human missions to the Red Planet. Our project combines interactive 3D maps with NASA-based information, allowing users to explore Martian terrain through different layers, including surface features, elevation, free-air gravity, and crustal thickness. It also highlights important geological formations, exploration sites, and rover missions, such as Curiosity and Perseverance, helping users discover the planet's most significant locations and routes. Additionally, ASTROMARS features Clifford, a virtual robotic companion that guides users through survival scenarios and explains essential conditions for living on Mars, such as air, water, temperature, pressure, and radiation. Its interactive games also teach users about astronaut spacesuits and their components. ASTROMARS addresses the challenge by bringing Martian exploration data, navigation, and survival education together in one accessible platform. Our goal is to make Mars exploration more interactive, understandable, and accessible while inspiring the next generation of space explorers.
details:
Project Details ASTROMARS

ASTROMARS is an interactive educational platform designed to make learning about Mars an engaging and accessible experience. It allows users to explore the planet through interactive 3D maps, different geographical and scientific layers, important locations, geological formations, and rover exploration routes. Users can also interact with Clifford, our original robotic dog character, who guides them through survival scenarios and explains important factors such as air, water, temperature, pressure, and radiation. Additionally, our Play section includes interactive astronaut suit activities and challenges that allow users to learn while having fun.

One of the main benefits of ASTROMARS is that anyone can use it, regardless of their age or previous knowledge of space. Instead of being just a website filled with text, it offers an intuitive and interactive experience where people can explore, experiment, and learn at the same time.

Our expected impact is to increase people's knowledge and interest in Mars, including its geography, environmental conditions, exploration missions, and the challenges humans may face when living there.

For its development, we used HTML and website creation software, which helped us build and organize the platform. We also incorporated NASA-related information and exploration resources to support the educational content.

The creativity of our project comes from combining different interactive features into one platform. We also created Clifford from scratch, designing and drawing our own robotic dog character to give ASTROMARS a unique identity and make learning more engaging.

Throughout development, we considered accessibility, intuitive navigation, educational value, scientific information, user interaction, and the importance of understanding the conditions astronauts may encounter on Mars. Our goal was to create an experience that combines technology, science, and creativity to bring Mars closer to everyone.
